description: This file defines an Angular component named 'Row' which extends a dynamic rendering component. It includes styling, template, and logic for a flexible row layout with configurable alignment and distribution properties.

classes.name: Row
classes.description: An Angular component for rendering a flexible row layout with configurable alignment and distribution.

methods.name: alignment
methods.description: Input property to set the alignment of items within the row, defaults to 'stretch'.

methods.name: distribution
methods.description: Input property to set the distribution of items within the row, defaults to 'start'.

methods.name: classes
methods.description: Computed property that generates CSS classes based on alignment and distribution settings.
